description: Native macOS GUI framework for Rust: every view a real AppKit control (NSTableView, NSOutlineView, NSTextView), updated in place by fine-grained signals.
rules: Read AGENTS.md first: views are built once and updated by signals; never rebuild views or native models per update.
Ferrokit is macOS only (15 or later); everything runs on the main thread. Use spawn_local, background or spawn for async and blocking work.
An app's main is a plain fn main ending in App::run, not #[tokio::main]; keep a tokio runtime in a OnceLock for tokio libraries.
Verify changes with cargo ferrokit check, which runs the app's CHECK=all self-checks.
